entries.claim: The selected v2 ordinary-basis 4-by-4 construction has 48 products and 204 other operations, with plain recursive leading coefficient 59/8. The retained independent exact replay checks the finite bilinear identity and ordinary-basis straight-line program, including rejection of corrupted inputs.
assumptions: The independent replay is restricted to the exact finite ordinary-basis identity and its 204-operation program; it is not a replay of alternative-basis recurrences or a universal theorem in a prover.
The existing FP32 pilot's evaluation order and zero-ULP predicate remain its contract. Algebraic equivalence alone does not preserve floating-point output, workspace, traffic or target timing.

entries.title: Conditional family 109 integer multiplication bound
entries.claim: The pinned selected-result record reports conditional kappa = 23/10000 = 0.0023 for zxv's #4359 productive-helper construction. Archived #4441 and #4470 claim 0.00300105 and 0.00302015; #4483 retains 0.00302015 with sufficient supplier rank 2^2800000000. The intake record marks those three partially reviewed and merged for archive only; the selected frontier remains 0.0023.
assumptions: The selected record, AI-assisted changed-interface review and supplied 23-stage/59-artifact validation receipt were inspected; their verifiers and complete transitive proof stack were not independently replayed or reviewed here.

Native producer/movement, fixed-tape execution, precision, fine-prime padding, analytic decomposition and exact recovery remain inherited premises; no complete formal or independent human verification of the multiplication theorem is supplied.

Later package statements and intake dispositions were inspected, not independently replayed. Archival merge is not scientific admission; sufficient supplier rank and its exponent reductions are neither a multiplication-input threshold nor a measured speedup.
entries.next_action: Keep selected and archival claims distinct; require source-bound replay and review of changed compiler/native/outer interfaces before treating a stronger claim as admitted. Identify a large exact-arithmetic workload, freeze its model assumptions and operand sizes, then compare complete time and storage with simpler algorithms before requesting CI timing.
